INSPECTION OF PUMP RELAY AND RESISTOR

1. INSPECT OF FUEL PUMP RELAY
HINT: The relay is located in the left cowl side of engine
compartment.

[Diagram label:]
FPR
FP
PR
+B
FI113A

A. Inspect Relay Continuity
(a) Using an ohmmeter, check that there is continuity between terminals +B and PR.
(b) Check that there is continuity between terminals +B and FPR.
(c) Check that there is no continuity between terminals +B and PR.

If continuity is not as specified, replace the relay.

B. Inspect Relay Operation
(a) Apply battery voltage across terminals +B and FPR.
(b) Using an ohmmeter, check that there is continuity between terminals +B and PR.
(c) Check that there is no continuity between terminals +B and FP.

If operation is not as described, replace the relay.
